name: pulumi
notes: Converts the actual get.pulumi.com shell installer with a minimal independently authored download_tarball override and one argument-quoting fix. The hosted entrypoint is pinned by SHA-256; a public Git commit or complete installer license has not been established. Changed source bytes fail the build for reanalysis.

Keeps upstream extraction, existing-install upgrade behavior and CLI layout. Uses the official --no-edit-path option; the authored wrapper writes prefix/env.sh and Bash completion so users can explicitly source that file. The environment file persists update-check suppression and disabled automatic plugin acquisition.

Before creating installation directories, the wrapper rejects forwarded --version or --install-root values that differ from the fixed recipe version and outer --prefix. It permits --silent and --no-edit-path, validates arguments, and invokes the installed CLI by absolute path.

Installs official random provider v4.21.6 through pulumi plugin install --file with its SHA-256 and --reinstall. The YAML language runtime is included in the official CLI archive. Other providers and language package dependencies are not included.

Tests a file backend and a deterministic local RandomInteger resource, including up, output, destroy and stack removal. This needs no cloud account; cloud deployment is outside scope. Native Pulumi engine/provider communication uses loopback RPC while the container has no external network.

Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 glibc test baseline. The bundled CLI and random provider are binary resources; source-license notices for this catalog do not establish redistribution rights for every bundled binary dependency.
